fees.note: Single-trip oversize permit $30 (96 h). If the load is also overweight, the combined oversize-and-overweight permit on the overweight line replaces it.
Single-trip oversize-and-overweight permit up to 125,000 lb gross: $60 (96 h).

$0.012 per mile per 1,000 lb above 80,000 (= $0.024/ton-mile of excess). State rounds miles up to 50, pounds up to 25,000 and the fee to nearest $10; min $80, max $540. Also required when any axle exceeds non-divisible axle limits even under 125,000 lb.
